pages.text: An imperfect ritual that channels the protective essence of Malum's hallowed gold, surrounding the bearer in an oaken carapace.$(br2)$(bold)Requires:$() Malum$(br2)$(bold)Setup:$()$(br)Place a Block of Hallowed Gold on top of an Imperfect Ritual Stone.$(br2)$(bold)Cost:$() 3000 LP per use$(br2)$(bold)Duration:$() 15 minutes

pages.title: Effects
pages.text: $(bold)Activation:$()$(br)Right-click the Imperfect Ritual Stone to receive:$(li)$(thing)Stone Ward$() for 15 minutes$(br2)$(bold)Stone Ward:$()$(br)Malum's Stone Ward effect surrounds the user in an oaken carapace, increasing their defenses and providing significant protection against damage.$(br2)$(bold)Use Cases:$()$(li)Defensive combat preparation$(li)Dangerous exploration$(li)Boss encounters$(br2)$(italic)Blood and spirit unite as one.$()
